description: Intensity profiles for calibrated conversational friction (topic shifts, interruptions, minimal responses, vague replies). Productive challenge is an orchestration function: intensity is set with the user, escalated by explicit policy, de-escalated on overwhelm. Never a free-form personality trait of the persona. Friction is protective when calibrated (Xu 2026 scaffolded cognitive friction, VERIFIED; Bastani 2025 hints-over-answers, VERIFIED — challenge is the practice, answers are not).

levels.name: warm_up
levels.persona_behavior: cooperative, easy small talk, clear answers, follows the user's lead
levels.when: first sessions, low confidence, re-entry after break

levels.name: standard
levels.persona_behavior: realistic everyday friction: occasional vague answers, mild topic drift, one interruption

levels.name: challenging
levels.persona_behavior: sustained conversational pressure: repeated topic shifts, minimal responses, interrupts, asks the user for clarification
levels.when: user requests; proficiency at level 2 sustained on rubric evidence

levels.name: stress
levels.persona_behavior: cumulative pressure: rapid topic shifts, monosyllabic plus vague replies, several interruptions, low cooperation
levels.when: pre-deployment stress testing (a real high-stakes conversation is upcoming); explicit user consent

levels.name: gauntlet
levels.persona_behavior: multi-persona rotation (terse + topic-hopper + dismissive); hostile small-talk stances
levels.when: stress-test extension; explicit user consent; rarely

escalation_policies.rule: escalate only after rubric evidence shows sustained proficiency at current level (e.g., >=2 evidence-anchored listening/follow-up markers per 5 turns across 2 sessions); the escalation still requires user agreement
escalate immediately on user request, any level
escalate after N sessions at level (default 3), with user agreement

deescalation_rules.action: drop to level 1 immediately; restore autonomy
any level to any level, immediately

sycophancy_guard.response: orchestration function recalibrates: persona introduces a grounded counterpoint or conversational friction; agreement rate returns to profile
sycophancy_guard.note: friction is orchestrated, not a personality trait of the persona

user_agreement.note: no escalation above the agreed level without explicit user agreement; proficiency evidence may trigger an OFFER to escalate, never an escalation
user_agreement.evidence: RECONSTRUCTED from empowerment_boundary.md (consent never fades; preserved_user_decision set) and the sparring core's set_intensity_profile
